resolvedQuestions.question: What process, relay, and client architecture preserves Pi RPC semantics while tolerating mobile disconnects?
Which Pi RPC commands and events map to session lists, streaming chat, tool activity, and approvals?
What state model and reconnection protocol prevent duplicated prompts, lost deltas, or stale approvals?
Which security and network exposure model is safe for a coding agent with workspace tool authority?
How should PWA notifications, background limits, and Claude-style mobile UX be implemented and phased?
Independent validation of the accumulated architecture

keyFindings.summary: Relay is lifecycle owner of a persistent RPC child; strict-LF JSONL framing requires serialized stdin writer and response/event demux.
Prompt acceptance differs from run settlement (agent_end vs agent_settled); post-acceptance failures arrive via events.
Streaming deltas assemble by contentIndex; message_end/tool_execution_end are authoritative; tool progress is replace-on-update.
get_entries(since) is a durable cursor; no list-sessions command exists, so the relay owns the session catalog.
Approvals map to the Extension UI sub-protocol (extension_ui_request/response dialogs), fully functional in RPC mode.
Browser WebSocket has no backpressure and per-connection ordering only; relay must add sequencing, replay, and dedup.
RPC command surface maps to composer/control plane plus get_commands actions menu (TUI-only builtins excluded).
Chat bubbles assemble from get_messages/get_entries plus live stream; four message roles render distinctly.
Direct bash is a privileged terminal surface (arbitrary shell, bypasses LLM tool path): explicit relay authorization + audit or out of MVP.
Session list is relay-built from --session-dir scanning plus entry tree metadata; fork/clone/get_tree support Claude-style session UX.
Approvals are extension-UI dialogs; decision-ready cards plus relay reporting/enforcement of the extension/relay policy are the parity differentiators (no native Pi permission-mode flag).
Claude UX parity model: chat-as-control-plane, streaming shells, full-width touch cards, structured tappable inputs with text fallback.
Reconnect protocol: server monotonic seq per stream, persist-before-fan-out, replay seq>cursor, cumulative ACKs; WebSocket is transport only.
Client mutations need clientMutationId + server idempotency record; Pi's id field is correlation-only.
Reconciliation: get_entries(since)+leafId+get_state; invalid cursor forces full snapshot via get_messages/get_tree.
Pi-child crash window makes prompt outcome indeterminate; dedup decided by post-restart entry reconciliation.
Approvals are epoch-scoped: unique dialog ids, stale/duplicate responders rejected, child restart invalidates outstanding dialogs.
Compaction firstKeptEntryId and entry-tree APIs act as snapshot barriers forcing full-entry refresh for old cursors.
Serve is the correct exposure: tailnet-only, identity-aware, auto-TLS; Funnel is public-internet and rejected for an agent relay.
Tailnet identity is reachability, not authorization; OWASP WebSocket checklist applies fully.
Relay needs per-action authorization matrix gating privileged RPC actions with audit and payload-digest-bound approvals.
Workspace containment: OS sandbox/least-privilege child, session files sensitive, metadata-only retention with digests.
Public WebSocket bridge viable only with full OWASP layer; strictly more attack surface than Serve.
Audit and incident response are design elements: security event logging without tokens/payloads, rotation/revocation, OWASP test list.
Approval extension is a trust control: admin-owned, hash/version-pinned, fail-closed for side-effect tools; extension bypasses its own UI.
iOS Web Push gated: Home Screen install required (iOS 16.4+), explicit user gesture, userVisibleOnly only.
Service workers are event-driven, not daemons; no Background Sync on WebKit; client cache evictable; relay is source of truth.
Push payload contract: RFC 8291 aes128gcm encryption, small opaque event-ID payloads, subscription secrets, VAPID discipline.
Notifications are committed-transition hints, never decision carriers; approvals revalidate in foreground.
Offline is stale read-only with explicit outbox retry; approval decisions never made offline.
Phase by verified authority: 0 local MVP, 1 exposure+auth, 2 approvals, 3 mobility/push, 4 parity; executable gate per phase.
Settlement semantics code-verified: rpc-client resolves run completion on agent_settled.
get_session_stats is the active-session dashboard metadata source (message counts, tokens, cost, contextUsage); session-list metadata still comes from get_state + relay catalog.
Negative evidence reconfirmed: no idempotency/client-mutation fields in installed RPC implementation.
Session mutations (new_session/switch_session/fork/clone) are cancellable by extension handlers; catalog treats them as request-outcome pairs.
Session-dir layout undocumented; --session-dir remains the only sanctioned custom location; catalog needs a filesystem probe.

Executable acceptance matrix G1-G9 maps every phase gate to a defined pass criterion; G5 requires canonical tool-call digest recomputation immediately before execution with fail-closed mismatch handling.

ruledOutDirections.direction: direct browser-to-Pi stdio
ruledOutDirections.reason: Browsers cannot consume a child-process stdin/stdout protocol.

ruledOutDirections.direction: one-shot Pi process per prompt
ruledOutDirections.reason: Makes the socket the lifecycle owner and loses the async run boundary.

ruledOutDirections.direction: treating prompt acceptance as run completion
ruledOutDirections.reason: Contradicted by the RPC contract.

ruledOutDirections.direction: using the transient RPC event stream as the durable session catalog
ruledOutDirections.reason: Durable entries exist separately; events lack replay cursors.

ruledOutDirections.direction: surfacing TUI-only commands in the mobile menu
ruledOutDirections.reason: TUI-only builtins do not execute via prompt.

ruledOutDirections.direction: treating tool_execution_start as an approval request
ruledOutDirections.reason: Approvals are exclusively extension-UI dialogs.

ruledOutDirections.direction: copying Claude Remote Control permission-mode model verbatim
ruledOutDirections.reason: Pi has no equivalent flag; relay must mirror Pi's actual extension-gated tool policy.

ruledOutDirections.direction: wall-clock replay cursors
ruledOutDirections.reason: Must be monotonic server sequence per stream.

ruledOutDirections.direction: auto-resending in-flight prompts after Pi-child crash
ruledOutDirections.reason: Duplicate risk; surface indeterminate instead.

ruledOutDirections.direction: client-side approval timeout tracking
ruledOutDirections.reason: Agent-side timeout auto-resolve is authoritative.

ruledOutDirections.direction: broker-side dedup alone
ruledOutDirections.reason: Bounded windows do not cover long-lived runs; consumer-side idempotency mandatory.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Tailscale Funnel as the exposure path
ruledOutDirections.reason: Public-internet listeners without per-visitor identity.

ruledOutDirections.direction: tailnet identity as sole authorization
ruledOutDirections.reason: It authenticates reachability only.

ruledOutDirections.direction: direct public WebSocket bridge as the default
ruledOutDirections.reason: Strictly more attack surface than Serve.

ruledOutDirections.direction: storing full mutation payloads indefinitely
ruledOutDirections.reason: Metadata-only retention with digests is safer.

ruledOutDirections.direction: silent pushes or background compute on iOS
ruledOutDirections.reason: WebKit requires user-visible notifications.

ruledOutDirections.direction: relying on Background Sync for delivery
ruledOutDirections.reason: Scheduled, not real-time; broken on WebKit.

ruledOutDirections.direction: client cache as canonical state
ruledOutDirections.reason: Evictable under storage pressure.

ruledOutDirections.direction: decision-carrying push payloads
ruledOutDirections.reason: Pushes are unreliable hints.

ruledOutDirections.direction: treating switch_session/fork/clone as unconditional transitions
ruledOutDirections.reason: They can be cancelled by extension handlers.

residualRisks.mitigation: approval-time payload digest binding PLUS canonical tool-call digest recomputation immediately before execution with fail-closed mismatch handling; gate G5 must include mutate-after-open attempt

residualRisks.risk: Relay crash behavior (envelope persistence, ledger recovery, approval-map restore)
residualRisks.mitigation: designed; gate G3 must include relay-restart mid-stream

residualRisks.risk: Serve PROXY protocol + Origin validation integration
iOS push on real device (Home Screen, gesture-grant, delivery)

residualRisks.mitigation: implementation-time verification of Pi extension loading
